lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>attack<c> made from a distance. Also called a
long-range attack.

Mostly done with <c:ffff00>actions<c> of the <c:ffff00>{{shooting}} skill<c>. The
<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> stat of the <c:ffff00>legs<c> affects both attacker and
the one who <c:ffff00>responds<c>.

<c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c> decides an <c:ffff00>{{attack_failure}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>.
Only the {{gatling}} can also <c:ffff00>{{graze}}<c> for little <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c>.
